data.name: Hasoun
data.gender_notes: Hasoun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘hasuna’ which means ‘gift’ or ‘blessing’. In Islamic tradition, the name Hasoun is believed to represent the blessings and favors bestowed upon a child by Allah. The name Hasoun carries the meaning “Gift, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hasoun usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah’s blessings and favors upon us.
data.etymology: Hasoun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Blessing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasoun total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: حسون
in_arabic.meaning: حسن و جمال کا مطلب، خوبصورت، نیک
in_arabic.long_meaning: حسن و جمال کا مطلب، خوبصورت، نیک۔ یہ نام حسن کے معنی میں ہے جو خوبصورتی اور نیکی کا مظہر ہے۔ قرآن مجید میں اس کا ذکر نہیں ہے، لیکن عربی دنیا میں حسن اور جمال کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں حسن کے نام کی اہمیت ہے، خاص طور پر حسن بن علی کے حوالے سے۔

in_urdu.name: حسن
in_urdu.long_meaning: حسن کا مطلب خوبصورت، نیک، اچھا ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے اور اسلامی دنیا میں حسن کے معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ حسن بن علی، اہل بیت کے رکن، کی شخصیت سے وابستہ ہے۔ یہ نام حسن و جمال کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हसन
in_hindi.long_meaning: हसन का अर्थ सुंदर, अच्छा, नेक होता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से निकला है और इस्लामी दुनिया में हसन के अर्थ में प्रयोग किया जाता है। हसन बिन अली, अहल बयत के सदस्य, की शख्सियत से जुड़ा है। यह नाम सुंदरता और अच्छाई के महत्व को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: حسن
in_pashto.long_meaning: حسن د ښایست او نیکۍ معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه راغلی او د اسلامي نړۍ کې د حسن په معنی کارول کیږي. حسن بن علي، د اهل بيت غړی، د دې نوم سره تړاو لري. دا نوم د ښایست او نیکۍ ارزښت ښيي.

in_english.name: Hasoun
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hasoun is derived from the Arabic root 'ḥ-s-n', meaning beauty and goodness. It signifies someone who is beautiful, good, and kind. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, the concept of 'ḥusn' (beauty) is highly valued in Islam. Historically, the name is associated with Hasan bin Ali, a grandson of Prophet Muhammad. The name embodies the qualities of beauty, morality, and spiritual growth.

Furthermore, it encourages parents to inculcate a sense of gratitude and humility in their child, cultivating a deeper connection with their faith.

historical_references.reference: Al-Hasun bin Sabah was the founder of the Ismaili state of Alamut in the 11th century in Persia. He is known for his military prowess and his patronage of scholars and philosophers. His reign lasted from 1092 to 1138 CE.
historical_references.context: Founder of the Ismaili state of Alamut in Persia and notable for military and patronage of scholars.

historical_references.reference: Al-Hasan Al-Wuzra was a famous scholar and poet during the Fatimid Caliphate in Egypt in the 13th century. He was known for his works on logic, philosophy, and poetry. He served as the vizier (chief advisor) to the caliph Al-Adil Kamel during his reign from 1279 to 1290 CE.
historical_references.context: Famous scholar and poet during the Fatimid Caliphate in Egypt, who served as the vizier and was known for works on logic, philosophy, and poetry.
